no_rule_findings.finding: Only a September 2024 council motion instructing LAHD to report on algorithm-based rent-setting software and the feasibility of a ban. It is not an enacted ordinance, so this document shows no rule at the city level.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.

parsed.doc_summary: A September 3, 2024 Los Angeles City Council motion (Councilmember Hutt) asking LAHD to report on the use of algorithmic rent-setting software and on whether a ban is feasible. It is a motion, not a rule, so it is reported only as a no-rule finding. It also mentions San Francisco's July 2024 legislation, but gives no operative terms for it.
